title: Luke and Vader Clash with Lightsabers Topps Star Wars Battle Of Endor #89
descriptionText: The Topps Star Wars Battle Of Endor #89 trading card features a thrilling scene from Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi, depicting a lightsaber clash between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader. Manufactured in 2021, this card is part of the base set for the Star Wars franchise collection. Made of card stock and in standard size, this non-sport trading card is a must-have for fans of action, sci-fi, and adventure genres. With its iconic characters and exciting imagery, this collectible single is sure to be a prized addition to any collection.
